name: Direct Chaser
description: Always moves toward the closest prey using maximum allowed force; prioritizes closing distance quickly to achieve a tag.

name: Predictive Lead
description: Estimates the prey’s velocity and position a short step ahead to intercept more efficiently, reducing chase duration.

name: Flanking Interceptor
description: Approaches prey from the side, maintaining an offset to block escape routes and improve tagging odds without colliding with the ally.

name: Coordinated Shadow
description: Keeps a strategic relation to the ally predator (e.g., offset behind or to the side) to create pounce-ready pressure while avoiding interference.

name: Delayed Pouncer
description: Approaches prey in a standard chase but intentionally delays the final sprint, baiting a commitment from the prey before surging for the tag.

name: Unpredictable Drift
description: Incorporates small, bounded random variations in heading to disrupt prey prediction and increase surprise tagging opportunities.
